title: Adidas Shoe Size Chart & Fit Guide
primaryKeyword: Adidas Shoe Size Chart & Fit Guide
metaDescription: Adidas shoe size conversion guide across US, UK, EU, and Japanese cm standards for Ultraboost, Samba, Superstar, and Stan Smith.
directAnswer: Adidas uses fractional third sizing for European conversions, where a US Men's 9 converts to EU 42 2/3 (UK 8.5) and a US Men's 10 converts to EU 44 (UK 9.5). Adidas shoes generally offer a slightly wider toe box than Nike, fitting true to size for standard-width feet.

faq.question: Why does Adidas use fractional EU sizes like 42 2/3?
faq.answer: Adidas translates UK full and half sizes directly into European Paris points, resulting in 1/3 and 2/3 European fractional increments.

faq.question: Do Adidas Sambas fit true to size?
faq.answer: Adidas Samba and Gazelle models fit true to size length-wise, though they have a low-profile, snug forefoot.

faq.question: How do Adidas Ultraboost running shoes fit?
faq.answer: Ultraboost models with Primeknit uppers fit snug like a sock; runners with wider feet often prefer a half size up.
